t: A consequence with a shape to it
a: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ نَسُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَأَنسَىٰهُمْ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
p: Wa lā takūnū ka-lladhīna nasu-llāha fa-ansāhum anfusahum…
m: And be not like those who forgot Allāh, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
